'''Corvin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|man]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Corvin lived on Dalicron-4, with his wife and his son, [[Zanner]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Zanner went missing during a storm and Corvin feared that his son had been swept into a river. However, a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents found Zanner in a nearby wood.
